metadata.case_name: YAU TSZ HIN v. BROADWAY THEATRE CO LTD

injuries.description: acute fracture of the fourth sacral vertebra
source: a magnetic resonance imaging study showed that she had an acute fracture of the fourth sacral vertebra but there was no direct compression on her nerves.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified fracture of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: contusion of sacral nerves to the bladder associated with the traumatic fracture of the fourth sacral vertebra resulting in neurogenic hypo-contractile bladder
source: the plaintiff had a neurogenic hypo-contractile bladder resulting from contusion of sacral nerves to the bladder associated with the traumatic fracture of the fourth sacral vertebra.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of sacral spine

manifestations.description: residual pain in the lower back and sacral area
paraesthesia in both legs after prolonged sitting (over both feet and front of legs up to the knees), relieved by standing and walking
inability to enjoy more vigorous sports or activities such as jogging, hiking and go-karting (could still swim)
urinary dysfunction: weak urine stream, requiring abdominal strain to void, unable to empty bladder with residual urine of around 30%; neurogenic hypo-contractile bladder
mild weakness at defaecation and needing to squat to effect bowel motion
two instances of urinary incontinence (one when ambulance arrived and once in Kwong Wah Hospital)

treatments_received: Ambulance transport to Kwong Wah Hospital
Presentation to Union Hospital on 2009-07-02 and admission (orthopaedic care)
Orthopaedic follow-up (including scan confirming sacral fracture had united)
Cholinergic drug to help initiate bladder contraction (given and later discontinued in 2011)
treatments_future: regular urological follow-up (the urologists were agreed that the plaintiff needed to have regular urological follow-up to monitor her progress and that the estimated cost was $10,000 per year).

possible trial of alpha-adrenergic blockers to try to increase urine flow rate and reduce residual urine (This would cost an additional sum of $5,500 per year) - trial only if objective response demonstrated and such treatment has not been adopted by the plaintiff's treating doctor.
Applying the undisputed multiplier of 19 (for medical expenses) to the annual sum of $10,000, the award on account of future medical expenses would be $190,000.

losses.description: urinary dysfunction and related bladder disability: "the plaintiff had a neurogenic hypo-contractile bladder resulting from contusion of sacral nerves to the bladder ..."; weak urine stream, inability to empty bladder with residual urine ~30%
mild weakness in defaecation and needing to squat to effect bowel motion

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: inability to enjoy more vigorous sports or activities such as jogging, hiking and go-karting, though she could still swim

comparable_cases.case_name: Sze Sing Nin v Hip Hing Construction Co Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: plaintiff fell from a height of 15 feet to the bottom of a tank, resulting in the fracture of his third lumbar vertebra with severe posterior displacement and a marked compression onto the nerve roots in his spinal canal; continued symptoms included constant back pain radiating to the right thigh, inability to squat or lift heavy objects and pain on bending, pain in the left thigh with numbness, inability to pass urine smoothly and involuntary dripping of urine when he lifted heavy objects or coughed or felt unwell, and impaired sexual function

comparable_cases.case_name: Lauw Ka Fong v Best City Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: plaintiff fell from a ladder and suffered a fracture at the first and third sacral vertebrae; persistent pain in the lower back after prolonged sitting or walking, lower back stiffness and right leg numbness on prolonged sitting; difficulty in ascending or descending stairs, unable to squat; pain on sleeping in certain positions; unable to have sexual intercourse resulting in marriage break-up
